results.description: Serialize manifest -> deserialize -> re-serialize and compare exact SHA256 digests
Two separate instances with identical values must produce identical JSON and SHA256
Verify all 8 Def families are present and free of legacy sentinel/delimiter strings
Verify float boundary and fractional values preserve exact precision across round-trip
Verify Korean, Japanese, German umlauts, quotes, tabs, newlines round-trip without corruption
Verify null fields remain null in JSON and do not collapse to empty string or sentinel
Verify activeMods loadOrder, Verbs list order, Hediff stages sequence, and Comps order are preserved
Verify Def family lists sort deterministically by defName ordinal via CanonicalNormalize
Manifest with shuffled unordered collections produces exact identical JSON and digest as pre-sorted instance
ValidateContract returns true with empty failureReason on representative compliant manifest
TryAdmitManifest successfully validates and admits compliant manifest producing non-empty canonical JSON
Changing a single scalar value must produce a distinct JSON and digest
Verify MANIFEST_SCHEMA_VERSION is ADR-006B-v5, CONTENT_CONTRACT_VERSION is ADR-006B-v5-R7, SUPPORTED_COVERAGE_PROFILE and MOD_PATCH_SUPPORT_STATUS match
Verify assemblies and stats sort deterministically using secondary tie-breaking keys
